holdout_card.fact_statement: Concrete blocks were thrown at police officers during the violence in Rotherham.
holdout_card.source_span: South Yorkshire Police reported that 51 officers, as well as police dogs and horses, were injured during the violence in Rotherham, where concrete blocks, chairs, fire extinguishers and tree branches were thrown at them.
